title: Compose Store Graphql Api
description: Replace compose-store JSON-RPC with GraphQL over HTTP, wire native KitStore for backbone commands, add GraphiQL dev config in launch.json.
summary: Finished compose-store workspace wiring: renamed the Cargo package and binary from semio-store to compose-store, added the local script.ts router for build/dev/test, routed Nx targets and VS Code launch through that router, aligned runtime readiness/env naming with COMPOSE_STORE_PORT, and fixed stale store materialization test pointers. Verified cargo run -p compose-store readiness/shutdown, cargo test -p compose-store, bun nx run @semio-tech/compose-store:build, and bun nx run @semio-tech/compose-store:test.
